title: Stripe API Reference
excerpt:
API Reference
Ask about this section
Copy for LLM
View as Markdown
The Stripe API is organized around
REST
. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts
form-encoded
request bodies, returns
JSON-encoded
responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.
You can use the Stripe API in
sandboxes
without affecting your live data or interacting with banking networks. The API key that you use to
authenticate
the request determines whether the request runs in live mode or in a sandbox. Sandboxes support all v2 APIs. Test mode sandboxes support some
v2 APIs
.
The Stripe API doesn’t support bulk updates. You can work on only one object per request.
The Stripe API differs for every account as we release new
versions
and tailor functionality.
